intended_use.summary: Source suitability reassessment for the owner-selected EarthExplorer full Level-2 bundles of the exact 10 and 26 August 2026 Landsat-9 pair. Signed-in bundle availability is observed; this record grants no request, download, pixel read, map inclusion, or scientific action.

sources.name: USGS Landsat-9 C2L2 SR 10/26 August pair via EarthExplorer

evidence.note: USGS STAC item IDs LC09_L2SP_141040_20260810_20260811_02_T1_SR and LC09_L2SP_141040_20260826_20260827_02_T1_SR, scene IDs, dates, path/row, and exact candidate asset roles were captured.

criteria.note: Catalog identity is exact enough to propose QA intake, but no band, QA, or MTL bytes have been authenticated.

evidence.note: USGS is the producer of Collection 2 Level-2 Landsat 8-9 science products and identifies EarthExplorer as a distribution route.

criteria.note: Producer and proposed distribution host are the same public agency; this is not independent event corroboration.

evidence.note: Owner-signed-in EarthExplorer session displayed the full Collection 2 Level-2 Product Bundle option for both exact scene IDs; each showed a rounded 1.05 GiB size. No download was activated.
Sanitized browser observation with both exact products, required member availability, and explicit no-transfer limitation.

criteria.note: The exact full-bundle option is visible under the owner-signed-in EarthExplorer session. Actual download completion, exact bytes, archive members, and durable access are unverified and require separate controlled intake.

evidence.note: USGS states Landsat products have no use restrictions and supplies the Landsat 8-9 Level-2 dataset citation.

criteria.note: This supports local QA use of the source data, not acceptance of any owner account condition or authority to publish project-derived pixels.

evidence.note: Exact USGS scene identifiers, acquisition times, path/row, cloud values, source IDs, and STAC transforms are recorded.

criteria.note: A future transfer must still bind filenames and MTL identity to these exact catalog items; metadata is not a binary checksum.

evidence.note: Host-specific two-bundle plan corrects MTL.json to MTL.txt plus MTL.xml, freezes archive-member identity and local SHA-256/length/structural checks, and states no upstream digest or exact bytes were observed.

criteria.note: Pass concerns a proposed post-acquisition integrity plan only, not any downloaded or verified bundle.

evidence.note: Both exact Landsat-9 scene footprints cover AOI-SOURCE and AOI-UPPER-CORRIDOR, with catalog 30 m EPSG:32645 QA and band assets on a common lattice shifted 40 columns.

criteria.note: Pass is only for attempting local QA after authority and verified intake. Scene cloud fractions and catalog transforms do not establish AOI pixel usability, residual registration, a visual map, or change.

evidence.note: Selected browser transport would keep cookies, tokens, account identifiers, and signed URLs out of files, shell history, logs, and receipts; data would remain outside Git.

criteria.note: No account secret is retained or requested by this assessment.

permitted_without_further_authorization: prepare local zero-decision USGS EarthExplorer bundle intake controls and review
requires_explicit_authorization: request or download either full bundle
read source archive or pixel bytes
claim mapped change or event causation
